subject.title: refactor: consolidate channel and auto-reply tests

question: Should this protected, test-only consolidation land after the branch is refreshed against current `main` and its retained queue/ingress coverage is confirmed?
rationale: The proposed code appears bounded and CI-backed, but the repository's protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human merge decision.

options.title: Review refreshed test refactor
options.body: Rebase or refresh the merge result, confirm the named queue and ingress cases remain intact, then approve the focused cleanup.

options.title: Request a narrower split
options.body: Ask for separate PRs if maintainers prefer independent review of auto-reply and durable-ingress test helper changes.

recommendation.title: Review refreshed test refactor
recommendation.body: Rebase or refresh the merge result, confirm the named queue and ingress cases remain intact, then approve the focused cleanup.
